observation_summary: The compiler throws 'JSC_MSG_NOT_INITIALIZED_USING_NEW_SYNTAX' or 'JSC_MSG_TREE_MALFORMED' errors when user code contains variables prefixed with 'MSG_'.
reasoning_summary: The compiler was incorrectly treating user-defined variables starting with 'MSG_' as internationalization (i18n) messages, triggering validation errors during advanced optimizations. The fix involved explicitly disabling the 'MSG_CONVENTIONS' warning level in the compiler options when i18n is not explicitly requested, preventing the compiler from enforcing its internal message naming conventions on user code.
